text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":26,"why":"Patient described swelling starting 'half an hour' ago."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":36,"why":"Patient stated 'half an hour' for swelling development."},{"i":2,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not report chest tightness or difficulty breathing."},{"i":3,"v":"INFERRED","u":33,"why":"Patient's reported symptoms of lip swelling and difficulty breathing infer breathing problems and swelling."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":59,"why":"Patient mentioned 'asthma' and 'Salbutamol inhalers'."},{"i":5,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not mention having an injection for peanut allergy as a child."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":61,"why":"Patient confirmed using Salbutamol inhalers for asthma."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":87,"why":"Doctor advised patient's mother to call 999 and use antihistamines."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":88,"why":"Doctor instructed patient's mother to call 999 and send ambulance."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":94,"why":"Doctor advised patient to book a review after discharge to consider prescribing an epipen."}]}
